ITEM 1 | Cluster of cooked sausage-like rounds, medium brown with darker browned edges and slightly glossy sheen, sliced into thick coins about 2.5 cm diameter and 1.5 cm tall, several pieces stacked/overlapping in upper-left of plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Whole smooth red grapes, deep burgundy to dark red with slight waxy sheen, about 1.5-2 cm diameter each, round and firm, grouped in center-left of plate (about 10 grapes) | 110
ITEM 3 | Cubed orange melon, bright orange-yellow flesh with slightly fibrous, moist surface, cut into irregular chunks roughly 2-3 cm per side, a few pieces with pale rind edges, in upper-right of plate | 130
ITEM 4 | Whole raw almonds, tan-brown with smooth papery skin and slightly ridged shape about 2.5 cm long, dry matte surface, scattered in a loose heap on right side of plate (about 50 nuts) | 150
